simple.meaning: צָהַב (tsâhab) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to glitter , i.e. be golden in color.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezra, beginning at Ezra 8:27. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָהַב (H6668) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H6668. tsaheb or tsahob [ צָהֹב צָהֵב, , compare Lag BN 31 ] verb gleam (Late Hebrew id. (of face, bronze, etc.); Arabic be red ); — Hoph`al Participle מֻצְהָב נְחשֶׁת Ezra 8:27 polished bronze (so Late Hebrew and-apparently Hebraism - ᵑ7 2Chr 4:16 ).
